description: This file defines the CatalogViewModelService class, which provides methods to retrieve catalog items, brands, and types for UI presentation in an ASP.NET Core application. It interacts with repositories and composes view models and select list items.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: UI-specific service for retrieving catalog view models and select list items, working with repositories and composing view models.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and paginates catalog items filtered by brand and type, returning a view model with catalog items and pagination info.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves catalog brands, returning them as select list items including an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves catalog types, returning them as select list items including an 'All' option.
